question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Longitudinal ATAC-seq/CUT&RUN after transient stimulus
ideas.description: Stimulate cells (e.g., injury, TNF, or growth factor), then profile chromatin accessibility and AP-1 (FOS/JUN) binding at multiple time points through washout and weeks later. Persistent AP-1 motif-containing open regions after signal withdrawal would indicate a retained chromatin memory.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation or dominant-negative perturbation during priming vs. recall
ideas.description: Use degron-tagged JUN/FOS or A-FOS to remove AP-1 either only during the priming stimulus, or only during the later challenge. If memory needs AP-1 during priming (for establishment) and/or recall (for maintenance), enhancer accessibility and the faster or stronger secondary transcriptional response will be lost accordingly.

ideas.title: Prime-and-rechallenge transcriptional response assays
ideas.description: Measure RNA-seq or nascent transcription (PRO-seq) and single-cell responses to a second stimulus after varying rest intervals in primed vs. naive cells. Link the magnitude of the response to the pre-existing AP-1 occupancy at each gene's enhancers, and map how long the memory lasts and how many cell divisions it survives.

ideas.title: Optogenetic or synthetic AP-1 activation sufficiency test
ideas.description: Briefly induce AP-1 using optogenetic or chemically inducible FOS/JUN, with no natural stimulus. Then test whether it creates stable accessible enhancers, histone marks (H3K27ac, H3K4me1) and an altered response to later signals, including after division. This tests whether AP-1 activity alone is sufficient to establish memory.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome and lineage tracing in vivo
ideas.description: Use scATAC+RNA with lineage barcodes or AP-1 reporter/fate-mapping alleles in tissue such as skin wound repair, to follow descendants of previously AP-1-active cells. Compare their accessibility and function with those of AP-1-naive siblings, and test whether the memory is inherited through division and linked to AP-1 recruitment of BAF (SWI/SNF) and chromatin remodelers.
